---
title: "Baseline ctDNA detection"
date: 2026-08-20
format:
  html:
    toc: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Baseline is the earliest valid ctDNA sample collected strictly before
treatment initiation. No randomization-day window is used. Patients without a
qualifying sample remain in the selected-patient accounting with an explicit
“no qualifying sample” status; they are not coded as ctDNA-negative.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source(here::here("analysis", "_module-common.R"), local = FALSE)
liqplat_source_public_helpers()
config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- module_force()
stage_id <- "implementation_baseline_detection"
result_dir <- module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "04-implementation"))
checkpoint_path <- module_checkpoint_path(stage_id)
summary_path <- file.path(result_dir, "baseline-detection-summary.parquet")
patient_path <- file.path(result_dir, "baseline-detection-patient-status.parquet")
figure_path <- file.path(result_dir, "baseline-detection-status.svg")
ctdna_path <- file.path(module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "00-data")),
                        "analysis-ctdna-samples.parquet")
cohort_path <- file.path(module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "00-data")),
                         "analysis-cohort.parquet")
if (!file.exists(ctdna_path) || !file.exists(cohort_path)) {
  stop("Baseline detection requires the built ctDNA sample table and cohort.")
}
input_paths <- c(ctdna_path, cohort_path,
                 private_domain_path(config, "ctdna_samples"),
                 schema_domain_path(config, "ctdna_samples"),
                 schema_domain_path(config, "cohort_follow_up"))
input_paths <- input_paths[file.exists(input_paths)]
output_paths <- c(summary_path, patient_path, figure_path)
decision <- checkpoint_decision(
  checkpoint_path, stage_id, input_paths = input_paths,
  output_paths = output_paths,
  code_paths = here::here("analysis", "04-implementation", "04-baseline-detection.qmd"),
  config = config, force = force
)

if (identical(decision, "skip")) {
  baseline_summary <- read_result_table(summary_path)
} else {
  samples <- read_result_table(ctdna_path)
  cohort <- read_result_table(cohort_path)
  require_public_columns(samples, c("sample_id", "id", "sample_date", "ctdna_detected"),
                         "baseline detection")
  if (!all(c("lod_q1", "lod_q3") %in% names(samples))) {
    stop("Baseline detection requires LOD-derived validity; `lod_q1` and `lod_q3` are missing.")
  }
  sample_date <- parse_analysis_date(samples$sample_date, "sample_date")
  lod_q1 <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(samples$lod_q1)))
  lod_q3 <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(samples$lod_q3)))
  samples$attempted_sample <- !is.na(sample_date)
  samples$ctdna_error_derived <- as.integer(
    samples$attempted_sample & is.na(lod_q1) & is.na(lod_q3)
  )
  samples$valid_ctdna_result <- samples$attempted_sample &
    samples$ctdna_error_derived == 0L
  if (!"treatment_start_date" %in% names(samples)) {
    if ("treatment_start_date" %in% names(cohort)) {
      treatment <- cohort[, c("id", "treatment_start_date"), drop = FALSE]
      samples <- merge(samples, treatment, by = "id", all.x = TRUE,
                       suffixes = c("", ".cohort"))
    } else {
      stop("Baseline definition is pending: treatment_start_date is unavailable in the public interface.")
    }
  }
  samples$treatment_start_date <- parse_analysis_date(
    samples$treatment_start_date, "treatment_start_date"
  )
  sample_date <- parse_analysis_date(samples$sample_date, "sample_date")
  if (!"id" %in% names(cohort) || !"tx" %in% names(cohort)) {
    stop("Baseline detection requires canonical cohort columns `id` and `tx`.")
  }
  selected <- cohort[validate_binary(cohort$tx, "tx", allow_missing = FALSE) == 1,
                     , drop = FALSE]
  qualifying <- !is.na(samples$id) & !is.na(sample_date) &
    !is.na(samples$treatment_start_date) &
    sample_date < samples$treatment_start_date &
    !is.na(samples$valid_ctdna_result) & samples$valid_ctdna_result
  baseline <- samples[qualifying, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(baseline) > 0L) {
    baseline$.sample_date_order <- sample_date[qualifying]
    tie_columns <- intersect(c("sample_id", "alteration_id"), names(baseline))
    tie_values <- if (length(tie_columns) == 0L) {
      rep("", nrow(baseline))
    } else {
      do.call(paste, c(baseline[tie_columns], sep = "\r"))
    }
    baseline <- baseline[order(baseline$id, baseline$.sample_date_order,
                               tie_values, na.last = TRUE, method = "radix"), ,
                         drop = FALSE]
    baseline <- baseline[!duplicated(baseline$id), , drop = FALSE]
    baseline$.sample_date_order <- NULL
  }
  selected_ids <- unique(as.character(selected$id[!is.na(selected$id)]))
  baseline_ids <- as.character(baseline$id)
  detection <- validate_binary(baseline$ctdna_detected, "ctdna_detected")
  detection_lookup <- stats::setNames(detection, baseline_ids)
  patient_detection <- unname(detection_lookup[selected_ids])
  patient_status <- data.frame(
    id = selected_ids,
    baseline_status = ifelse(is.na(patient_detection),
                             "no_qualifying_sample", "valid_baseline"),
    ctdna_detected = patient_detection,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  detected <- patient_status$ctdna_detected
  valid_baseline <- !is.na(detected)
  baseline_summary <- data.frame(
    n_selected = nrow(patient_status),
    n_valid_baseline = sum(valid_baseline),
    n_no_qualifying_sample = sum(!valid_baseline),
    n_detected = sum(detected == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_not_detected = sum(detected == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    detection_proportion_valid_baseline = if (sum(valid_baseline) == 0L) NA_real_ else
      mean(detected[valid_baseline] == 1),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  write_module_table(baseline_summary, summary_path)
  write_module_table(patient_status, patient_path)
  if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'ggplot2' is required for the baseline-detection figure.")
  }
  status_counts <- as.data.frame(table(patient_status$baseline_status,
                                       useNA = "ifany"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(status_counts) <- c("baseline_status", "n")
  observed_detected <- patient_status$ctdna_detected[valid_baseline]
  status_counts <- rbind(
    status_counts,
    data.frame(baseline_status = "valid_not_detected",
               n = sum(observed_detected == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  )
  plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(status_counts, ggplot2::aes(baseline_status, n)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col() +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Selected patients") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal()
  assert_artifact_path(figure_path)
  ggplot2::ggsave(figure_path, plot = plot, width = 7, height = 4, units = "in")
  finalize_module_checkpoint(
    stage_id = stage_id,
    checkpoint_path = checkpoint_path,
    input_paths = input_paths,
    output_paths = output_paths,
    config = config,
    metadata = list(data_lock = config_get(config, "analysis", "data_lock"),
                    status = "built", baseline_definition = "earliest_valid_pre_treatment"),
    code_paths = here::here("analysis", "04-implementation", "04-baseline-detection.qmd")
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: baseline-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Baseline ctDNA detection summary"

baseline_summary |>
  knitr::kable()
```
